net_income_basis: GAAP income attributable to parent; not consolidated ProfitLoss including NCI
cash_basis: Cash and cash equivalents at carrying value; exclude restricted cash, marketable securities and equity investments
capex_basis: Gross cash PP&E purchases plus separately reported productive-asset capitalization not already included; exclude business combinations, noncash acquisitions and sale proceeds
debt_basis: Current and noncurrent interest-bearing borrowings excluding finance leases, plus current and noncurrent finance-lease liabilities once
bank_basis: Period-end common equity less goodwill and other intangibles net of associated deferred-tax liabilities; Standardized CET1/RWA; nonaccrual retained amortized-cost loans / gross retained amortized-cost loans before allowance, excluding held-for-sale and fair-value loans
reit_basis: Unadjusted Nareit FFO attributable to common; gross property asset purchases plus development/improvements and other productive-asset capitalization, without duplicate components or business combinations
duplicates: Intersect declared rounding intervals; select most precise consistent value, then source_id/fact_id; conflicting intervals stay unresolved
evidence_selection: Prefer a complete path using verified sources; keep unverified observations for draft calculations only when an admissible path is missing; never hide conflicts among verified observations
missing: No zero, interpolation, alternate accounting basis or favorable source declaration inferred from absence
flows: Direct exact TTM, four contiguous fiscal quarters, or FY + current YTD - prior YTD; all available paths must reconcile within propagated rounding intervals

reviewed_concepts.other_productive_capex: Gross cash productive-asset capitalization excluded from the PP&E/property lines; no business combinations; explicit evidenced zero if none
reviewed_concepts.debt_current: Current interest-bearing borrowings including current maturities, excluding finance leases
reviewed_concepts.debt_noncurrent: Noncurrent interest-bearing borrowings excluding finance leases
reviewed_concepts.preferred_equity: Preferred equity carrying amount; explicit evidenced zero if none
reviewed_concepts.noncontrolling_interest: Noncontrolling interest carrying amount; explicit evidenced zero if none
reviewed_concepts.common_equity: Equity attributable to parent common shareholders, excluding preferred and NCI
reviewed_concepts.tangible_common_equity: Period-end common equity less goodwill and other intangibles net of associated deferred-tax liabilities; not average capital or per-share reconstruction
reviewed_concepts.nonperforming_loans: Nonaccrual retained loans measured at amortized cost; exclude NPA, held-for-sale and fair-value loans
reviewed_concepts.gross_loans: Gross retained amortized-cost loans before allowance; same scope as nonperforming_loans
reviewed_concepts.ffo_common: Unadjusted Nareit FFO attributable to common; exclude normalized/adjusted/diluted FFO and AFFO
reviewed_concepts.reit_property_purchases: Gross cash property asset purchases, excluding business combinations and amounts included in development/improvements
reviewed_concepts.reit_development_improvements: Gross cash property development and improvements, excluding amounts already included in property purchases
reviewed_concepts.common_income: GAAP net income available to common shareholders, after preferred dividends
reviewed_concepts.ebit: Reported GAAP operating income; no constructed pretax-plus-interest substitute or addbacks
reviewed_concepts.parent_income: GAAP net income attributable to parent, excluding NCI
reviewed_concepts.cfo: Consolidated reported cash from operating activities
reviewed_concepts.ppe_capex: Gross cash purchases of PP&E excluding other productive capex separately supplied

source_policy: Document origin, delivery host and verification are separate; issuer-hosted actual filings need identity/content evidence, not byte equality to SEC HTML; unauthenticated mirrors remain draft
publication_policy: Exact timezone-aware timestamp or whole local calendar-day interval in an explicit IANA timezone; require entire interval at or before cutoff
identity_policy: Exact legal-entity context; dated predecessor aliases require referenced evidence and unchanged reporting-basis declaration; never equate a URL directory with a financial entity
